claims: Chipotle is hosting its 6th annual Hockey Jersey BOGO on April 20, 2026.
The Hockey Jersey BOGO offers a buy-one-get-one-free entrée deal to anyone wearing a hockey jersey into a U.S. or Canada restaurant after 3 p.m. local time.
The Hockey Jersey BOGO has a limit of five free items per transaction.
The Hockey Jersey BOGO occurs on Monday, April 20, 2026, from 3:00 PM to close.
Entrées eligible for the Hockey Jersey BOGO include burrito, bowl, salad, or tacos.
The Hockey Jersey BOGO requires wearing a hockey jersey of any team or level to a participating location.
The Hockey Jersey BOGO is in-person only.
The Hockey Jersey BOGO is not valid for online or delivery orders.
The Hockey Jersey BOGO celebrates the start of the Stanley Cup Playoffs.
Chipotle Rewards members can exchange 10 points for a chance to win one of 75 limited-edition "Chipper" jerseys via the Chipotle Rewards Exchange from April 18 to May 2, 2026.
The Hockey Jersey BOGO is designed to coincide with the NHL playoffs.
The Hockey Jersey BOGO generally applies to any hockey-related apparel, including jerseys from professional, college, or local leagues.
